templates.name: Hook title
templates.description: A loud opening line over your first clip, with a slow push in. Made for the first three seconds of a short.
templates.author: OpenRoll

templates.name: Lower third
templates.description: A name and a line of context in the bottom corner, on a dark plate with a gold edge.
templates.author: OpenRoll

templates.name: Chapter card
templates.description: A full screen divider with a chapter number and title. Drop it between two parts of a longer video.
templates.author: OpenRoll

templates.name: End card
templates.description: Thanks for watching over a softened clip, with a subscribe button and an arrow pointing at it.
templates.author: OpenRoll

templates.name: Quote card
templates.description: A square card with a large quote on paper colour, for sharing a line from the video.
templates.author: OpenRoll

templates.name: Countdown
templates.description: Three, two, one on a dark field with a ring that pulses on each number. Ends on the cut into your first clip.
templates.author: OpenRoll

templates.name: Three fast cuts
templates.description: Three clips, a little over a second each, with a punch zoom on every cut. A marker sits on each cut.
templates.author: OpenRoll

templates.name: Split screen intro
templates.description: Two clips side by side with a title across the join. Good for a before and after, or two people in one frame.
templates.author: OpenRoll

templates.name: Reaction split
templates.description: One clip over another in a vertical frame: the thing you are reacting to on top, you underneath.
templates.author: OpenRoll

templates.name: Beat montage
templates.description: Eight clips on a 120 beats per minute grid with a marker on every beat and a slot for the music. A skeleton to cut to.
templates.author: OpenRoll

templates.name: Memory recap
templates.description: Four clips that dissolve into each other under a warm film look, with a title over the first.
templates.author: OpenRoll

templates.name: Facecam bubble
templates.description: A round picture of you in the corner while the main clip plays full screen. For tutorials and commentary.
templates.author: OpenRoll

templates.name: Callout arrow
templates.description: A hand drawn circle, an arrow and a short label to point at something on screen.
templates.author: OpenRoll

templates.name: Follow reminder
templates.description: A small pill near the bottom asking for a follow, with a heart that pops in beside it.
templates.author: OpenRoll

templates.name: Glitch intro
templates.description: A short title sting: your clip tears and splits colour while the name slams in, then flashes into the next shot.
templates.author: OpenRoll

templates.name: Bold yellow highlight
templates.description: Heavy white letters with a black outline. The word being spoken turns yellow and each caption pops in.
templates.author: OpenRoll

templates.name: Clean white box
templates.description: Dark text on a soft white plate. Calm and easy to read on any footage.
templates.author: OpenRoll

templates.name: Karaoke word pop
templates.description: Large centred words, dimmed until spoken. The current word lights up green as the line pops in.
templates.author: OpenRoll

templates.name: Soft serif
templates.description: Quiet serif subtitles with a gentle shadow, for travel films and anything slow.
templates.author: OpenRoll
